reasoning: This commit refactored JettyStart.java to use SystemProperties (backed by org/exist/system.properties resource) for several log messages, including changing the correct `System.getProperty("exist.home")` call to `SystemProperties.getInstance().getSystemProperty("exist.home", "unknown")`. However, exist.home is a JVM system property set via -Dexist.home on the command line (as seen throughout build/launch scripts), and is never written into src/org/exist/system.properties. This mismatch causes the eXist Home log line to always print "unknown", which is exactly the bug that commit a8726173a9351b718b477ee1579a20c1b9a7a446 fixes by reverting to System.getProperty("exist.home", "unknown").
